questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(13, 40, 115)

(5, 16, 43)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: 

Logic: 1st number × 3 + 1 = 2nd number

2nd number × 3 - 5 = 3rd number.

Given:

For (13, 40, 115):

⇒ 13 × 3 + 1 = 39 + 1 = 40 = 2nd number

⇒ 40 × 3 - 5 = 120 - 5 = 115 = 3rd number

For (5, 16, 43):

⇒ 5 × 3 + 1 = 15 + 1 = 16 = 2nd numbe

⇒ 16 × 3 - 5 = 48 - 5 = 43 = 3rd number

Similarly, in Option (1)

For (11, 34, 97):

⇒ 11 × 3 + 1 = 33 + 1 = 34 (which should match 2nd number, but here it's 34, so logic seems different)

⇒ 34 × 3 - 5 = 102 - 5 = 97 (this holds true)

 

Hence, the correct answer is Option 1: (11, 34, 97).

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All crows are birds.

Some crows are pets.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pets are birds.

II. Some birds are crows.

options.text: Both Conclusions I and II follow.
Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04855ffdae97d88dd728c8ddafe7228f65a39a6b5a2c0684d03f4c52ce5f08a9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pets are birds → **Does not **follow (As all crows are birds and some crows are pets. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some birds are crows → Follow (As all crows are birds. As whole crows comes in birds, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only Conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth term in the same way as the first term is related to the second term and the fifth term is related to the sixth term.

18 ∶ 27 ∶∶ ? ∶ 36 ∶∶ 16 ∶ 24
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (2nd number ÷ 3) × 2 = 1st number.

Now,

For 18 ∶ 27

⇒ (27 ÷ 3) × 2 = 9 × 2 = 18.

For 16 ∶ 24

⇒ (24 ÷ 3) × 2 = 8 × 2 = 16.

Similarly, for ? ∶ 36

⇒ (36 ÷ 3) × 2 = 12 × 2 = 24.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

Six letters A, B, C, P, Q and R are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the letter on the face opposite to Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/385ef2b682ac815b5445f975f134b124d455e4f2f48d35d19f99de40c0a63a4c.png]
questions.solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'Q', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddb72eef319d47038f69286fadeb8c278a61aebf1c823b46d87c34a273b3f315.png] 

From both dices, A is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

A is opposite to A.

P is opposite to R.

So, B will be opposite to Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "B".
